# Design template contract

<!-- Generated by `make contract` from src/templates/ (context.rs, contract.rs,
contract_intro.md). Do not edit by hand: a unit test fails when this file
drifts from the code. -->

What every template of the public site receives. Templates are
[MiniJinja](https://docs.rs/minijinja) (Jinja2 syntax); HTML output is
auto-escaped by file extension, so emit pre-rendered HTML with `| safe`.

## Template resolution

A template name `X` loads `templates/X`, the first of:

1. `DESIGN_DIR/templates/X` — dev-only local folder.
2. The storage override `design/templates/X` — edited in the bucket or the
   admin Design page, applied by a design reload.
3. The baked default bundle (`design/templates/X` in the repository).

`{% extends %}`, `{% include %}` and `{% import %}` resolve the same way.
Static files follow the same order under `assets/`.

## Undefined values

Every variable below is always present; an absent value is `none` (test it
with `{% if x %}` or `x is none`), never undefined. Live rendering is lenient,
but the design smoke render (run before a design is published) renders every
template with strict undefined handling: referencing a variable or attribute
not listed here is an error.

## Filters

Besides MiniJinja's built-in filters:

- `timeformat(format="%d. %m. %Y %H:%M")` — formats a `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS[.f]`
  (or `T`-separated) timestamp or a `YYYY-MM-DD` date with a
  [chrono `strftime`](https://docs.rs/chrono/latest/chrono/format/strftime/)
  format; any other value is returned unchanged.
  Example: `{{ page.modified_at | timeformat("%d. %m. %Y") }}`.

## URLs

- `/assets/{path}` — a static file of the design (`assets/{path}`).
- `/files/{hash}` — a stored file's bytes by SHA-256; `/files/{hash}/nahled` —
  its thumbnail (images).
- `/{path}` — a page or menu item; `/` is the home menu item (path `""`).
- `/search` — search (`q`, `tag`, `path`, `limit`, `offset`); `/tag/{id}`
  redirects to `/search?tag={name}`.
- `/admin` — the admin; `/admin/pages/{id}/edit`, `/admin/menu/{id}/edit` edit
  a page or menu item.
- `/sitemap.xml`; `/{path}?format=pdf|slides` — the page exported.

## Templates

### `base.html` (layout)

Page skeleton every page template extends (`{% extends "base.html" %}`); children fill `{% block title %}` and `{% block content %}`.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `logged_in` | boolean | Whether the visitor has an admin session (private items are included). |
| `menu_list` | list of [`MenuItem`](#menuitem) | Visible menu entries in `order_index` order, flat. |
| `menu_tree` | list of [`MenuNode`](#menunode) | The same entries nested by path prefix (`/a` contains `/a/b`). |

<details><summary>Example context</summary>

```json
{
  "logged_in": true,
  "menu_list": [
    {
      "label": "Home",
      "path": "/"
    },
    {
      "label": "Notes",
      "path": "/notes"
    },
    {
      "label": "Rust",
      "path": "/notes/rust"
    }
  ],
  "menu_tree": [
    {
      "children": [],
      "label": "Home",
      "path": "/"
    },
    {
      "children": [
        {
          "children": [],
          "label": "Rust",
          "path": "/notes/rust"
        }
      ],
      "label": "Notes",
      "path": "/notes"
    }
  ]
}
```

</details>

### `path_page.html` (page)

Any other path: the menu item, else the page stored at that path.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `body_html` | string | The page's markdown rendered to HTML, directives expanded. Output it with `\| safe`. |
| `breadcrumbs` | list of [`Crumb`](#crumb) | Cumulative path segments of the page (empty for a menu item). |
| `logged_in` | boolean | Whether the visitor has an admin session (private items are included). |
| `menu_id` | integer or none | Id of the menu item, or `none` when the path resolved to a page. |
| `menu_list` | list of [`MenuItem`](#menuitem) | Visible menu entries in `order_index` order, flat. |
| `menu_tree` | list of [`MenuNode`](#menunode) | The same entries nested by path prefix (`/a` contains `/a/b`). |
| `page` | [`PageView`](#pageview) or none | The page, or `none` when the path resolved to a menu item. |
| `tags` | list of [`TagView`](#tagview) | Tags attached to the page (empty for a menu item). |

<details><summary>Example context</summary>

```json
{
  "body_html": "<p>Hello <strong>world</strong></p>",
  "breadcrumbs": [
    {
      "href": "/notes",
      "label": "notes"
    },
    {
      "href": "/notes/rust",
      "label": "rust"
    }
  ],
  "logged_in": true,
  "menu_id": null,
  "menu_list": [
    {
      "label": "Home",
      "path": "/"
    },
    {
      "label": "Notes",
      "path": "/notes"
    },
    {
      "label": "Rust",
      "path": "/notes/rust"
    }
  ],
  "menu_tree": [
    {
      "children": [],
      "label": "Home",
      "path": "/"
    },
    {
      "children": [
        {
          "children": [],
          "label": "Rust",
          "path": "/notes/rust"
        }
      ],
      "label": "Notes",
      "path": "/notes"
    }
  ],
  "page": {
    "created_at": "2026-01-02 10:00:00",
    "id": 7,
    "modified_at": "2026-03-04 12:30:00.123456",
    "path": "notes/rust",
    "private": false,
    "summary": "Notes on Rust",
    "tag_ids": [
      1
    ]
  },
  "tags": [
    {
      "description": "The Rust language",
      "id": 1,
      "name": "rust"
    }
  ]
}
```

</details>

### `page_search.html` (page)

`/search?q=&tag=&path=&limit=&offset=`.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | Page size (1–100, default 20). |
| `logged_in` | boolean | Whether the visitor has an admin session (private items are included). |
| `menu_list` | list of [`MenuItem`](#menuitem) | Visible menu entries in `order_index` order, flat. |
| `menu_tree` | list of [`MenuNode`](#menunode) | The same entries nested by path prefix (`/a` contains `/a/b`). |
| `next_offset` | integer or none | Offset of the next result page, `none` on the last. |
| `offset` | integer | Index of the first result shown. |
| `pages` | list of [`PageView`](#pageview) | The current result page. |
| `path_prefix` | string | Path prefix filter (`?path=`), empty when absent. |
| `prev_offset` | integer or none | Offset of the previous result page, `none` on the first. |
| `q` | string | Full-text query (`?q=`), empty when absent. |
| `tag` | [`TagView`](#tagview) or none | The tag named by `tag_name`, or `none` when absent or unknown. |
| `tag_name` | string | Tag filter as typed (`?tag=`), empty when absent. |
| `total` | integer | Number of matches across all result pages. |

<details><summary>Example context</summary>

```json
{
  "limit": 1,
  "logged_in": false,
  "menu_list": [
    {
      "label": "Home",
      "path": "/"
    },
    {
      "label": "Notes",
      "path": "/notes"
    },
    {
      "label": "Rust",
      "path": "/notes/rust"
    }
  ],
  "menu_tree": [
    {
      "children": [],
      "label": "Home",
      "path": "/"
    },
    {
      "children": [
        {
          "children": [],
          "label": "Rust",
          "path": "/notes/rust"
        }
      ],
      "label": "Notes",
      "path": "/notes"
    }
  ],
  "next_offset": 2,
  "offset": 1,
  "pages": [
    {
      "created_at": "2026-01-02 10:00:00",
      "id": 7,
      "modified_at": "2026-03-04 12:30:00.123456",
      "path": "notes/rust",
      "private": false,
      "summary": "Notes on Rust",
      "tag_ids": [
        1
      ]
    }
  ],
  "path_prefix": "notes",
  "prev_offset": 0,
  "q": "rust",
  "tag": {
    "description": "The Rust language",
    "id": 1,
    "name": "rust"
  },
  "tag_name": "rust",
  "total": 3
}
```

</details>

### `404.html` (page)

A path with no menu item or page, or a private one for an anonymous visitor.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `logged_in` | boolean | Whether the visitor has an admin session (private items are included). |
| `menu_list` | list of [`MenuItem`](#menuitem) | Visible menu entries in `order_index` order, flat. |
| `menu_tree` | list of [`MenuNode`](#menunode) | The same entries nested by path prefix (`/a` contains `/a/b`). |

<details><summary>Example context</summary>

```json
{
  "logged_in": false,
  "menu_list": [
    {
      "label": "Home",
      "path": "/"
    },
    {
      "label": "Notes",
      "path": "/notes"
    },
    {
      "label": "Rust",
      "path": "/notes/rust"
    }
  ],
  "menu_tree": [
    {
      "children": [],
      "label": "Home",
      "path": "/"
    },
    {
      "children": [
        {
          "children": [],
          "label": "Rust",
          "path": "/notes/rust"
        }
      ],
      "label": "Notes",
      "path": "/notes"
    }
  ]
}
```

</details>

### `markdown/page.html` (directive partial)

`<page path="…">` / `<page id="N">`.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inner_html` | string | Its rendered HTML. Output it with `\| safe`. |
| `path` | string | Path of the transcluded page. |

<details><summary>Example context</summary>

```json
{
  "inner_html": "<p>Transcluded</p>",
  "path": "notes/rust"
}
```

</details>

### `markdown/img.html` (directive partial)

`<image path="…" alt="…">`, and `<file>` of an `image/*` file.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `alt` | string | The `alt` attribute, defaulting to `title`. |
| `hash` | string | SHA-256 of the file: full size at `/files/{hash}`, thumbnail at `/files/{hash}/nahled`. |
| `title` | string | Last segment of the file's path. |

<details><summary>Example context</summary>

```json
{
  "alt": "Architecture",
  "hash": "9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08",
  "title": "diagram.png"
}
```

</details>

### `markdown/file.html` (directive partial)

`<file path="…">` of any other file.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | The file's description, defaulting to `title`. |
| `hash` | string | SHA-256 of the file, served at `/files/{hash}`. |
| `title` | string | Last segment of the file's path. |

<details><summary>Example context</summary>

```json
{
  "description": "The specification",
  "hash": "9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08",
  "title": "spec.pdf"
}
```

</details>

### `markdown/gallery.html` (directive partial)

`<gallery path="…">` / `<gallery id="N">`.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | Gallery id (unique per page render, e.g. for lightbox grouping). |
| `items` | list of [`GalleryItem`](#galleryitem) | The gallery's files in order; empty for an empty gallery. |
| `title` | string | Gallery title. |

<details><summary>Example context</summary>

```json
{
  "id": 3,
  "items": [
    {
      "hash": "9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08",
      "path": "holiday/beach.jpg",
      "title": "beach.jpg"
    }
  ],
  "title": "Holiday"
}
```

</details>

### `markdown/fen.html` (directive partial)

`<fen>`; the board is drawn client-side by `assets/js/chess-viewer.js`.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fen` | string | The FEN string. |
| `size_class` | string | `""`, `" size-sm"` or `" size-lg"` — append it to a class attribute. |

<details><summary>Example context</summary>

```json
{
  "fen": "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR b KQkq - 0 1",
  "size_class": " size-lg"
}
```

</details>

### `markdown/pgn.html` (directive partial)

`<pgn>`; the viewer is driven client-side by `assets/js/chess-viewer.js`.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `move` | string or none | The `move` attribute as written (`N`, `first`, `last`), `none` when absent. |
| `pgn` | string | The PGN text. |
| `size_class` | string | `""`, `" size-sm"` or `" size-lg"` — append it to a class attribute. |

<details><summary>Example context</summary>

```json
{
  "move": "2",
  "pgn": "1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6",
  "size_class": ""
}
```

</details>

### `markdown/mermaid.html` (directive partial)

`<mermaid>` and ```` ```mermaid ```` fences.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `size_class` | string | `""`, `" size-sm"` or `" size-lg"` — append it to a class attribute. |
| `source` | string | The Mermaid source. |
| `svg` | string | Server-rendered SVG; empty when rendering failed (then show `source`). Output it with `\| safe`. |

<details><summary>Example context</summary>

```json
{
  "size_class": "",
  "source": "graph TD\n  A --> B",
  "svg": "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"></svg>"
}
```

</details>

### `markdown/json.html` (directive partial)

`<json query="…" type="table">`.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `columns` | list of string | Column headers (empty when the result has no object rows). |
| `kind` | string | Render type; currently always `table`. |
| `rows` | list of list of string | Cell text, one list per row. |

<details><summary>Example context</summary>

```json
{
  "columns": [
    "name",
    "count"
  ],
  "kind": "table",
  "rows": [
    [
      "a",
      "1"
    ]
  ]
}
```

</details>

## Types

### `Crumb`

One breadcrumb: `a/b` yields `{a, /a}` then `{b, /a/b}`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `href` | string | Absolute URL of the path up to this segment. |
| `label` | string | The path segment. |

### `GalleryItem`

One gallery file.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `hash` | string | SHA-256 of the file: full size at `/files/{hash}`, thumbnail at `/files/{hash}/nahled`. |
| `path` | string | The file's full path. |
| `title` | string | Last segment of the file's path. |

### `MenuItem`

One menu entry.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | The menu item's title. |
| `path` | string | Absolute URL (`/` for the home page). |

### `MenuNode`

A menu entry with the entries nested under its path.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `children` | list of [`MenuNode`](#menunode) | Entries whose path continues this one; empty for a leaf. |
| `label` | string | The menu item's title. |
| `path` | string | Absolute URL (`/` for the home page). |

### `PageView`

A page as templates see it.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `created_at` | string | `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS[.f]` — format it with the `timeformat` filter. |
| `id` | integer | Page id (admin editor at `/admin/pages/{id}/edit`). |
| `modified_at` | string | `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS[.f]` — format it with the `timeformat` filter. |
| `path` | string | Canonical path without a leading slash; the page is served at `/{path}`. |
| `private` | boolean | Private pages are only rendered for logged-in visitors. |
| `summary` | string or none | Short description for listings. |
| `tag_ids` | list of integer | Ids of the page's tags. |

### `TagView`

A tag; its listing lives at `/tag/{id}`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `description` | string or none | Optional longer description. |
| `id` | integer |  |
| `name` | string | Unique tag name. |
